_comment: Read by scripts/check-npm-audit.py (pre-push hook and Dependency Audit). One entry per advisory, never per package. An expired entry fails the gate; renew it only with a reason that is still true.

exceptions.reason: No patched version exists (picomatch <= 4.0.7, advisory of 2026-10-19). The production path is @scalar/api-reference -> @unhead/vue 3.4.3 -> @unhead/bundler / unhead -> unplugin / vite -> picomatch, and in those packages only the build-plugin entries (@unhead/vue/vite, @unhead/vue/bundler, unhead/stream/unplugin, unhead/stream/vite) import it. Scalar loads @unhead/vue and @unhead/vue/client only, and no request reaches a glob pattern.
